_note: Clips that fail a phonetic gate and are shipped anyway, each with a reason a person checked. The gate still fails anything not named here, so a regression cannot hide behind a blanket threshold.

soundcity.i: Her /i/ is 190 ms and scores 0.89 against a 0.93 threshold. The threshold was calibrated on sustained IPA cardinal vowels, which no teacher produces: a real short /i/ is quick and moves a little. All four copies of this recording on her site are the same take, so there is no steadier one, and the alternative - taking /i/ from another speaker - would put a second voice inside every word with an i in it, which is the defect this whole pipeline exists to prevent. Checked by ear against sit, pin and dig. 2026-09-19.
